stories.title: Flintshire Council writes to Transport for Wales over ‘Tap and Go’ rail fare signage
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council’s chief executive has written to Transport for Wales asking for new signage at stations on the Wrexham to Bidston line, after Tap and Go ticket machines were found to charge full adult fares regardless of age or Railcard status. stories.title: New maternity safety scheme rolled out across Wales
stories.summary: A new scheme giving families a direct route to raise urgent concerns about a mother or baby’s deteriorating health is being rolled out in hospitals across Wales, but the minister responsible could not say when it would be running consistently everywhere. stories.title: Delays on M56 near Manchester Airport after multi-vehicle crash
stories.summary: Drivers heading to Manchester Airport are facing lengthy delays this morning after a multi-vehicle crash closed part of the M56. Traffic has been stopped on the M56 eastbound between junction seven for Bowdon and junction six for Hale, close to the airport.
